title: Aggregate Parties, Consents, Contact Points and Party Relationships contributions
objective: Advance repository step 12 with one behavior-neutral owner batch: expose stable owner-owned production contribution entry points and exact inventory factories for Parties, Consents, Contact Points and Party Relationships, merge them through crm-first-party-modules, and remove their ordinary registration or inventory bypasses from generic application runtime while preserving exact inventory, ordering and activation behavior.
deliverables: Parties exposes exact mutation/query definition factories and one activation-gated production contribution builder from an existing owner composition package
Consents exposes its exact mutation/query definition factories through its existing owner production composition and the first-party aggregate
Contact Points exposes exact mutation/query definition factories and one activation-gated production contribution builder preserving Party reference validation
Party Relationships exposes exact mutation/query definition factories and one activation-gated production contribution builder preserving Party reference validation
crm-first-party-modules creates shared Party references internally and merges Parties, Customer Accounts, Consents, Contact Points and Party Relationships in the accepted contribution order
generic application runtime consumes the four owners only through crm-first-party-modules for ordinary inventory and registration
native composition guards reject renewed direct definition or registration bypasses
the exact native-composition guard path is classified under the existing operations scope without classifying scripts broadly
Cargo.lock records only intentional internal path-edge changes and no package or external dependency version change
acceptance: public mutation/query coordinates, inventory contents and compatibility APIs are byte-for-byte equivalent in meaning and preserve their existing order
tenant activation, semantic reference validation, visibility authorization and transactional execution behavior are unchanged
Parties, Consents, Contact Points and Party Relationships ordinary registration or inventory bypasses no longer appear in generic native composition
first-party aggregate contains no repeated module identifiers or capability coordinates
scripts/check_native_module_composition.py selects the existing operations scope and Governance CI while an unclassified sibling script still fails closed
workspace package count and external dependency families and versions are unchanged
repository step 12 remains in progress and repository step 13 is not started
non_goals: complete repository step 12 for Identity Resolution, Customer Data Operations, Data Quality, Customer Enrichment, Sales/Activities, Customer 360 or other remaining owners in this batch
change product behavior, routes, coordinates, contracts, schemas, migrations, persistence or workers
create, remove, rename or consolidate crates
classify scripts/** or any broader script family as a safe affected scope
change external dependency versions or add a dependency family
change generic runtime algorithms beyond removing migrated owner registration or inventory wiring
start repository step 13 or later work
